question.html:
A person on a sledge is sliding along a horizontal surface at a speed of m s between points X and Y. When the sledge reaches point Y, it slides up a slope to point Z where it comes to rest for a moment. The surfaces are frictionless.

a. Outline why the sledge moves at constant speed between X and Y. In your answer, refer to Newton’s first law of motion.

  [1]

b. Describe the motion of the sledge from Y to Z. In your answer, refer to Newton’s second law of motion.

   [2]
